raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On 4× MI325X (gfx942), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash consistently segfaults during the second FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph-capture pass on the latest vllm nightly image -> `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-af1c01499b289be555c475669ba50a88e96d846e`

FULL_DECODE_ONLY and --enforce-eager start successfully. AMD_SERIALIZE_KERNEL=3 also makes FULL_AND_PIECEWISE reliable, indicating an asynchronous stream race.

## Suggested Fix

Disable the DeepSeek-V4.1 auxiliary attention streams on gfx942:


```
aux_stream_list = (
    None if on_gfx942() else [torch.cuda.Stream() for _ in range(3)]
)
```

Other ROCm architectures and CUDA retain the existing multi-stream path.

## Explanation

The V4.1 target model creates three auxiliary streams, while its ROCm MTP path already executes this work serially. On gfx942, asynchronous work from these streams can overlap PIECEWISE graph capture and cause a native worker segfault.

With auxiliary streams disabled only on gfx942, the real TP4 checkpoint completed all PIECEWISE and FULL graph captures, reached readiness, and handled concurrent prefill and decode requests. Neither --enforce-eager nor global kernel serialization was required.

After the fix the server completed FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph capture, reached readiness, and successfully handled both standalone prompts and concurrent prefill/decode requests with coherent outputs.

## Reproduction / Validation Command

Image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-af1c01499b289be555c475669ba50a88e96d846e`


Environment Vars:

```
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
```

Serving command:

```
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --port 8100 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --mm-encoder-attn-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --mm-processor-cache-type shm \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1,"video":0}' \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}'
```
